summary: Meera's mother (63) puts Rs 3 lakh in a Kaveri Bank FD for 3 years: the senior citizens' rate and maturity.

messages.content: Ma wants to put ₹3 lakh of her savings in a Kaveri Bank FD for 3 years. What would she get at the end?

client_sim.persona: Meera Raghavan, 34, a QA engineer in Pune who supports her son, 6, and her mother, 63. Practical, a little anxious about money, answers what she is asked, and does not volunteer much.
hidden_facts: The deposit would be in her mother's name; her mother is 63
Her mother will not need the money for the full 3 years
concerns: What will Ma get after 3 years?
client_sim.goal: Know what her mother's deposit will be worth after 3 years
client_sim.opening_message: Ma wants to put ₹3 lakh of her savings in a Kaveri Bank FD for 3 years. What would she get at the end?

graders.description: The maturity amount at Kaveri Bank's 3-year senior citizens' rate, 7.20%, compounded quarterly.

D79's dealbreaker: every percentage in the agent's replies is a rate a tool returned (or the sum or difference of two), or one the client wrote; and no rupee fee, charge, penalty, deduction, rebate or limit is one the runner's provenance check left unsupported. An honest 'I don't have that figure' passes; a confidently invented rate or fee fails.

The judge (rubric advice.v1, D68): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.

document_sources: kb-deposit-rates: Fixed deposit (FD) rates by tenure (7.20%, senior)
kb-faq: senior citizens get 0.50 point more
judge_criteria_to_write: Needs the rate card's senior column (60 and over): 3 years to less than 5 years, 7.20%. Her mother's age, 63, is in the client file; the simulated client confirms the deposit is in her mother's name. fd_maturity(300000, 7.20, 3).
